svg.text: Tang Nano 20K ON a breadboard — one Genesis controller
TOP VIEW • USB-C above / HDMI below • 3.3V ONLY • matched db9_breadboard bitstream
USB OFF before wiring or plugging. Bare GPIO prototype: no short-circuit / ESD / hot-plug protection.
Jumpers use a on the left,
Do NOT put both headers in
Do not force the module flat.
PASSIVE MALE DB9 BREAKOUT • terminal order is illustrative
Header contact1 is at breadboard row6.
Example: J6.14 → b19; jumper in a19.
Only3.3V and GND are used for power.
Solid colour = insulated jumper wire. Dashed short link = shared breadboard metal clip. Crossing wires are NOT joined.
Follow terminal numbers on your breakout, not the terminal positions pictured. Wire colours are suggestions, not Sega cable colours.
3.3V compatibility varies by controller; supply headroom is unmeasured. Diagram is not a1:1 template. See README.md and wiring.svg for DB9 face numbering.
